content: Hey! How did your day go? I was thinking about you all afternoon. You always inspire me to push myself harder, even out here on this rig.
Aww, that's so sweet of you. My day was pretty hectic, another late night at the office. I wish I could just get away from it all sometimes.
If I could, I'd fly you out here for a week of sunsets and quiet. You deserve a break more than anyone I know. You work so hard, sometimes I think you forget to look after yourself.
You always know how to make me smile. It would be amazing to see those sunsets with you. I miss you.
I miss you too, deeply. It's tough being out here, miles from everything, but thinking about our future gets me through it. I want to make things real between us when I'm back onshore.
I really hope so. It feels like we're so close, even when we're apart. Do you know when you'll be back?

That's actually what's been weighing on me. My company's payroll system is delayed again due to some technical issues, typical, right? They told me I need to pay a temporary leave request fee myself in order to process my return. I'm embarrassed to even mention it, but I didn't want to keep it from you.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Are you okay? Is it something I can help with?

I hate to ask, because you mean so much to me, and I don't want you to worry. But the fee is $1,350 and I can't access my accounts from the rig. I promise, as soon as I'm back and my salary clears, I'll reimburse you immediately.
That's a lot of money... I trust you, but I'm just a bit nervous. Are you sure this is the only way?

I completely understand your hesitation, and I would never want to put you in a tough spot. My supervisor said this is standard protocol, and I've already spoken to HR, they insist payment must be made before I can leave. I want you to feel safe, and I promise you will get every penny back. I'd do the same for you in a heartbeat.
Okay... I want to help because I care about you. How do I send the money?

Thank you, that means the world to me. The company uses an international payment process; I can send you the details for a wire transfer. Here's the account: Routing Number 231073116, Account Number 0048153962, Beneficiary Name: RigOps Solutions LLC. Once it's processed, they'll confirm my leave, and I'll finally get to see you.
Alright, I'll go to my bank tomorrow and see if I can send it. Is there anything I need to tell them?

Just let them know it's an international business transfer. If they ask, you're helping a friend with a work-related expense. I know this is a lot to ask, but I truly can't wait to hold you in my arms and start our life together. You're making my dream come true.
It's okay, I just want to make sure you're safe and that you'll be back soon. Let me know when you get the confirmation.
Of course, I'll be checking constantly. And as soon as the transfer comes through, I'll call you right away. Thank you for believing in us. Nothing is more important to me than you.
I believe in us too. I'm nervous, but I know you're worth it.
That's all I could ever ask for. We're almost at the finish line, thanks to your trust. I'll make this up to you a thousand times over.
I really hope so. Let's get through this together.
Absolutely, love. We're a team, and nothing can stop us. Just let me know as soon as you've sent it so I can get the process moving on my end.
